name: 时间参数的实际表示保持运行时校验
分支匹配结果不能当模板名
source:
run:
  - match_templates:
      cases:
        - template: a.png
          as: hit
          do:
            - tap_template: {template: $hit}

name: 分支匹配结果可以直接点击
source:
run:
  - match_templates:
      cases:
        - template: a.png
          as: hit
          do:
            - tap: $hit
            - tap: {position: $hit}
            - tap: $hit.center
            - tap_template: $hit.template

name: 查找返回值与字段
source:
run:
  - find: a.png
    as: hit
  - tap: $hit
  - tap_template: $hit
  - tap: $hit.score
  - log: $hit

name: 已声明参数类型
分支结果覆盖与恢复
source:
params:
  hit: {type: template}
run:
  - match_templates:
      cases:
        - template: a.png
          as: hit
          do:
            - tap: $hit
  - find: $hit

name: 动态自定义返回值不猜测
分支改写后类型不确定
source:
params:
  hit: {type: template}
run:
  - if: true
    then:
      - find: a.png
        as: hit
  - tap: $hit

name: 循环跨轮变量不误判
source:
params:
  hit: {type: template}
run:
  - repeat: 2
    do:
      - tap: $hit
      - find: a.png
        as: hit

name: 模板列表元素引用
source:
run:
  - find: a.png
    as: hit
  - find_any: {templates: [$hit, $hit.template]}

name: 函数参数到原生调用
source:
functions:
  f:
    params: {count: {type: integer}}
    run:
      - tap_template: $count

name: 本地函数调用参数
source:
functions:
  f:
    params: {target: {type: template}}
    run: []
  g:
    run:
      - find: a.png
        as: hit
      - f: $hit
      - f: $hit.template
